_comment: Contract for GET /api/data on the trading_daemon (port 8635), captured 2026-09-03
from the live daemon AFTER the Node cutover.
This is a CONTRACT, not a data snapshot. Balances move every 200ms, so pinning
values would fail on the first run and teach everyone to ignore the gate. What is
pinned is the shape and the invariants that a degraded poller would violate.
minAccounts is an operator-tunable FLOOR, not a fact. It was 109 at capture. It is
set below that on purpose so a routine fleet change does not go red - but it is NOT
set to 1, because 'accounts is non-empty' passes while the poller returns garbage.
If the fleet legitimately shrinks past this, editing this number is a deliberate act.
